recommendation: Keep the commit. It preserves the later recursive search behavior while aligning the active core search parameter with the FHIR-19527 move to SDC; additional SDC content changes, if any, belong in the SDC IG rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-19527 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked to move complex Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse extensions to SDC, rename questionnaire-enableWhen as questionnaire-enableWhenExpression, rename questionnaire-allowedProfile/questionnaire-allowedResource as questionnaire-referenceProfile/questionnaire-referenceResource, and remove questionnaire-studyProtocolIdentifier because useContext covered it.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites Git#ecdd7d61. That merge included 9b1695bfd416c4f23560a3e60b999b6c5600db58, which removed the named extension definitions from the core Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse extension spreadsheets as the core portion of the Questionnaire changes. Current core source no longer defines the moved extensions in the active Questionnaire or QuestionnaireResponse source directories.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse remain active resources in source/fhir.ini, so their search parameter bundles are in current build scope. SDC currently defines the response subject extension as sdc-questionnaireresponse-isSubject. The core QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject SearchParameter was introduced in 2021 with the old pre-move core URL and later made recursive by FHIR-49784 in 2025; that later issue changed traversal only and did not justify retaining the stale extension canonical.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml so QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject tests for http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/StructureDefinition/sdc-questionnaireresponse-isSubject instead of http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/questionnaireresponse-isSubject.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml: updated QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject expression to reference the SDC isSubject response extension canonical URL.

related_jiras.note: Applied 2025 FHIR-I issue made nested QuestionnaireResponse search expressions recursive; its traversal change was preserved while correcting the stale extension URL.
